subtasks.description: Define explicit immediate/finite/indefinite retention semantics and migrate the current ambiguous zero value safely.
Add legal-hold ownership, reason, expiry/review and audited release; separate hold from ordinary user preference.
Implement tombstone-first access denial, durable object/derived-data purge jobs and retry reconciliation.
Reapply deletion tombstones after restore and document backup expiry rather than promising instant backup erasure.
Add Persian/English text PII detection, configurable classes and restricted original-to-redacted mappings.
Route permitted analysis/retrieval/export to the correct redacted or original version and record policy provenance.
Test retention with a controllable clock, held records, failed storage deletion, mixed-language identifiers and subject-scope export.
